goal: Build a local-first macOS coding-agent harness that produces direct, evidence-backed Chinese answers while safely coordinating parallel child sessions, worktrees, terminal, browser, computer use, MCP, skills, hooks, and recovery.
description: The harness must exceed Claude Code in local durability, Chinese interaction quality, transparent evidence, and macOS-native control while matching its mature delegated-agent, permission, validation, and extensibility workflows.
tasks: Classify user intent and select an execution policy
Create a durable task contract and context projection
Schedule independent exploration, planning, implementation, verification, review, and debugging sessions
Enforce intent-first tool execution with scoped permissions
Validate changes continuously and route failures to a debug session
Merge evidence into concise final answers
Recover sessions, effects, and approvals after restart
Load skills, hooks, MCP tools, and plugins in isolated workers
safety_requirements: Intent and receipt for every side effect
No secrets in events, prompts, or exports
integration_requirements: Kimi API primary provider with ACP and CLI fallback
